what: Moved ECC to S/4HANA across Canada, APAC, Norway/UK and US (final go-live 1 Jan 2025) in 39 months, replacing 8-9 million custom code lines; 94% standard at go-live, 97% after upgrade.
Consolidating 12 ERP systems into one S/4HANA instance by 2028 on a new core data platform; CEO reports 97% fewer profit centres and 70% fewer cost centres so far.
Industrialised S/4HANA migration of 500+ group companies and 40,000+ users; 150+ companies already migrated, first nine in five months; completion planned early 2027.
Modern ERP programme moving off ECC (close to 20 years) to S/4HANA; process intelligence migrated 2,500+ processes and trained 1,100+ people in under 12 months; go-live not stated.
Greenfield standardised S/4HANA unifying Woodside and BHP Petroleum, delivered in 27 months with only 22 customisations (71% fewer than utility average) and 2,500+ users trained.

Maintenance Intelligence correlates SAP maintenance history with time-series data-lake equipment data; piloted on one asset, targeting up to 15% fewer maintenance hours over five years; about 50 AI agents in production.
S/4HANA in SAP private cloud built in under a year (Feb 2024 start), cut over in a few-hour window to go live 1 Jan 2025 with no operational downtime.
Integrated 20-year-old legacy ERP and DCP systems into its S/4HANA environment in about six months, with 100% data load and an on-time, on-budget go-live.
Finance moved to S/4HANA Record-to-Report across 53,000+ employees; 60% of reconciliations were automated within one month of go-live.
S/4HANA-based ERP went live in two releases (April and July 2021); reconciliations fell over 90% and HR tickets over 50% versus the old ERP.
